description_en: Queries a list of machines that are connected to Simple Log Service in a specified machine group

kebab_example: aliyun sls list-machines --project ali-test-project --machine-group test-group --offset 0 --size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMachines

parameters.description_en: The line from which the query starts. Default value: 0.

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100. Maximum value: 500.
